subject: FinEdge: Penetration testing — scope, methodology, and remediation plan
messages:
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@finedge.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finedge.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pen test report and scope questions — FinEdge

Marcus,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. Procurement needs the most recent penetration test evidence and a short note on methodology for our SOC 2 reviewer. A few specific asks from our side: 

- Can you provide a redacted copy of the full PT report (executive summary + findings)?
- Which standards/methods were followed (OWASP, NIST, etc.) and were any manual exploit attempts performed vs. automated scans?
- Is the report from a CREST-accredited firm and can we get their creds?
- What’s your "report age" acceptance policy for SOC 2 — we typically require testing within 9 months of our audit fieldwork.
- We also need a remediation tracker template so our security team can map fixes back to findings.

Appreciate if you can send the materials and a short note we can drop into the SOC 2 evidence folder.

Regards,
Sara Liu
Security Program Manager
FinEdge Inc.
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@finedge.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pen test report and scope questions — FinEdge

Sara —

Thanks for the note. Attaching a redacted copy of our most recent engagement along with a scope matrix and a remediation tracker template. Quick answers up front: 

- Report: redacted PDF attached (FinEdge_PT_Report_redacted.pdf). We removed exploit POCs and screenshots that contain customer data; executive summary, severity, and remediation guidance are intact.
- Methodology: engagement followed industry-standard methodology (OWASP Top 10 for web components, NIST SP 800-115 for test planning/execution, and CREST/OSCP-style manual validation for critical findings). Both automated scanning and manual exploitation were used where safe and necessary.
- Vendor creds: PenTestCo (our vendor) is CREST-accredited; I’ve attached their credential snapshot (pentestco_creds.pdf) and Alex from PenTestCo is cc'd on follow-up.
- Report age: Redwood accepts pen test evidence up to 12 months for standard SOC 2 evidence ingestion. We understand some auditors prefer 9 months; if your auditor insists, we can discuss a short-statement of continued controls or a scoped retest.
- Remediation: we included remediation_tracker.csv — please use that to map ticket IDs / Jira keys to findings. For SOC 2 evidence we can provide a redacted findings-to-control mapping table.

Notes on scope exceptions: this engagement excluded the dedicated on-prem backup appliance (we did not perform authenticated testing against that network segment). That exclusion is recorded in the scope_matrix.xlsx. If you need that included for the audit, we can arrange an add-on scoped test.

Next steps I propose: 1) Confirm if the auditor will accept a 12-month report, 2) if not, do you want a targeted retest for the excluded backup segment, and 3) provide PO/DocuSign link and we’ll schedule the retest window.

Attachments: FinEdge_PT_Report_redacted.pdf, scope_matrix.xlsx, remediation_tracker.csv, pentestco_creds.pdf

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive — Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Morales <alex.morales@pentestco.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@finedge.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pen test report and scope questions — FinEdge

Sara / Marcus —

Quick technical addendum from PenTestCo: 

- Methodology details: testing included discovery (passive + active), authenticated test cases using customer-provided service accounts, and manual verification of high-risk chains. We cite OWASP Top 10 and used NIST SP 800-115 for test planning and evidence collection.
- Remote vs on-site: the engagement was hybrid. All remote exploitation used a client-controlled VPN and a jump host provided by FinEdge; no persistent agents were installed. 
- Proofs and PII: POCs in the full report contain request/response traces; those are redacted for PII. We can provide an annotated verification log (redacted) and a short attestation that the redaction does not modify severity or remediation guidance.
- Credentials & staff: attaching our lead tester CV and CREST reference sheet. We are happy to provide a signed methodology attestation for your auditor.

If you want the attestation and lead tester CV in the SOC 2 folder we can stamp it and sign electronically.

—Alex Morales
Principal Consultant 
PenTestCo
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@finedge.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Alex Morales <alex.morales@pentestco.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pen test report and scope questions — FinEdge

Thanks, Marcus and Alex — very helpful. Two quick clarifications from our security desk: 

1) For the hybrid remote execution: can you confirm the jump host network CIDR and whether tests used NATed egress IPs? Our auditor needs to know the IPs they should expect in logs.
2) If we opt for a targeted retest for the backup appliance, can you provide an estimate (cost / days) and a proposed earliest window?

Also our auditor has asked whether Redwood will accept a partial retest statement (i.e., attesting that unchanged controls remain effective) in lieu of a full retest if the full report is 10–12 months old.

Sara
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@finedge.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Alex Morales <alex.morales@pentestco.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pen test report and scope questions — FinEdge

Sara —

Answers below: 

1) Jump host / egress IPs: PenTestCo used the jump host you provided. For the engagement the egress IPs were 18.203.45.112 and 18.203.45.113 (these are NATed addresses). We'll include a short network appendix in the SOC 2 evidence bundle that your auditor can match to firewall logs.

2) Targeted retest for backup appliance: estimated effort is 2 testers for 2 days (on-site or remote authenticated testing) — ballpark cost USD 9,800 and earliest window we can target is 2026-10-01 pending PO. If a full retest is preferred (covers regression and broader regression surface), budget ~4 tester-days USD 18k.

3) Partial retest / attestation: Redwood can provide a scoped attestation that previously validated controls remain in place and a focused verification of remediation items. For SOC 2 we typically accept either: (a) a full retest, (b) a partial retest focused on remediations & critical controls, or (c) a signed attestation from the testing vendor plus evidence of remediation tickets and verification logs. If your auditor requires a full re-test within 9 months we will follow your guidance; otherwise the 12-month report window is our default for SOC 2 evidence ingestion.

Next steps: Marcus — can you send the DocuSign PO link for the targeted retest option and I’ll block the team for the 10/01 window tentatively. Alex — please prepare the signed methodology attestation and the annotated verification log (redacted) for upload. Sara — if you approve the estimate we’ll issue the quote and DocuSign.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
